title: Colors
description: "JK-ui color system: semantic tokens, theme modes, and CSS variables for consistent, accessible UI colors."

## Prerequisites
JK-ui color tokens are defined using CSS variables and consumed through Tailwind utilities. Make sure your main stylesheet (usually `app.css`) is loaded globally and that JK-ui styles are included before any custom overrides.

Do not hardcode color values in your UI. Always rely on semantic tokens to keep your interface consistent, accessible, and theme-ready.

## Theme Modes
JK-ui supports multiple **theme modes** depending on how your application handles color schemes. You can configure your project to support both light and dark themes, or restrict it to a single mode.

| Mode | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `both` | <TableDescription>Defines color variables for both light and dark themes. Recommended for most applications that support theme switching.</TableDescription> |
| `light` | <TableDescription>Defines color variables for light mode only. Use this when your application does not support dark mode.</TableDescription> |
| `dark` | <TableDescription>Defines color variables for dark mode only. Useful for dark-first or terminal-like interfaces.</TableDescription> |

## Theme Settings

Define in @inline-theme. Once defined, you can use utilities like `bg-primary`, `border-border`, or `border-success` anywhere in your UI.
